notes.title: Dev news for Cozy Beach- Controller support coming soon & more cool stuff!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Cozy Beach Fans![/p][p]Summer's finally over, but we're keeping the summer vibes going with Cozy Beach![/p][p]We just wanted to drop an update with how things are going behind the scenes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/25e9271e2964b58113e98e89e47cbbff85d1b6b3.png"][/img][/p][p]We've been hard at work on a big update for the demo.[/p][p]New features include:[/p][p]-Detailed settings page with display, audio and other options[/p][p]-Controller support[/p][p]-Steam Deck support[/p][p]-Re-mappable controls[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/1c26109a09598a425bbac5180ce36d39297d84b4.png"][/img][/p][p]We're ironing out some bugs and will be sending it to our playtesters, and then out to Steam.[/p][p]We hope to have it on Steam in the next 2-3 weeks, altho since these settings are more complex systems that affect a lot of the game so far, there could be additional setbacks.  We want to get an update out asap tho, so we may roll out features as they're ready instead of all at once.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/eed897f14736d6e69bc0cfa220e2424d5e4c3919.png"][/img][/p][p]We are very eager to add in new fun content to the demo, but it's much easier for dev to add these system-wide features in at the start, instead of trying to retrofit them later into existing features.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/574d4c75678373b007c5a19369e9a7bda64e0f38.png"][/img][/p][p]Once we get the settings/controller update out, we are working on some fun new content for the demo![/p][p]-We started designing the character creator so you can customize your kitty avatar and try on new clothes-[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/5b11b8a1ca6dfe597f13b3a8045ef23c49e60f3c.png"][/img][/p][p]-We're also working on a quest line for Capy so you can help them out by exploring the island and catching tons of fish![/p][p]-We're adding a more fish in the ocean to catch - the more, the merrier![/p][p]-A new mystery character![/p][p]-Localization is also on the way - we are localizing to French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Thai.  Want another language?  Let us know![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/c5a9ba48e4a6d19a8de4966f1b453499c7f9c8fc.png"][/img]The plan is to release this update in November.  We have a lot of work to do on these features but want to get them added to the demo soon for a more enjoyable experience![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/38a74fde8ab41f6cb1655d1c49f7ef2a69b93101.png"][/img]If you want to playtest Cozy Beach and try out features before they come to Steam-[/p][p] [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdKTISOAzWcjf9EmmQ5bM7ChFgZIKdw6uMFnWQV_OcPNA-SFA/viewform" style="button"]Sign up here![/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now - keep your eyes out for the update announcement soon![/p][p]Thanks so much for reading and supporting Cozy Beach![/p]

notes.title: Cozy Beach is featured in the Dames 4 Games Slumber Party Showcase!
notes.notes: [p]Awesome news, this is something we are so thrilled about!! Cozy Beach was selected for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45664741-Dames-4-Games/sale/dames4gamesslumberpartyshowcase"]Dames 4 Games Slumber Party Showcase[/url] - it's both a rad Steam event and a really cool stream showing off all the games![/p][p][/p][p]We were in an video for the showcase where we talked about the development of the game featuring two of our team members, and we talk about making the game, the game's aesthetics and the progression of the capsule art- it's a really fun vid, we had a great time putting it together![/p][p][/p][p]The showcase aired earlier today, you can check out the replay of our 2-min segment at this link![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/live/LL_Dg3oFDU4?si=HAFrKyEelFe8FWVS&t=1485"][/dynamiclink][/p][p](with an extra shout-out from host AYChristene! 😻 [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/live/LL_Dg3oFDU4?si=wvtAgdOZlJToveH1&t=1828"][/dynamiclink])[/p][p][/p][p]Here are all the games in the event, all made in some part by awesome women in games.  There are some great picks in there - check 'em out:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45664741-Dames-4-Games/sale/dames4gamesslumberpartyshowcase"]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45664741-Dames-4-Games/sale/dames4gamesslumberpartyshowcase[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to Dames 4 Games for hosting the showcase and including Cozy Beach!! 🫶  We had a fabulous time and are so proud to be a part of the 2025 Slumber Party Showcase![/p]

notes.title: Friday Update - Demo Patches
notes.notes: [p]Hey Cozy Beach Fishers![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a very exciting week for our dev team - we've been working hard on the demo and were very excited to see it released on Monday for Steam's Fishing Fest.  We got some amazing placement in the festival and are really glad we participated![/p][p][/p][p]We've also been patching the game- our dev has been hard at work finding solutions to the little bugs that popped up at the last second.  The demo is in good shape, we still have some bugs to fix here and there - details are below, and see [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3489070?emclan=103582791475002000&emgid=511835551706382400"]our post on Weds[/url] for more patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll continue to work on patching the bugs for this initial version of the demo, and shortly after that we'll start to add in some new exciting features!  Controller and Steam Deck support, character customization, NPC quests, more fish, emotes, apparel, silly emotes and more are planned to be rolled out over the year.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep an eye on the game for updates, or [url="https://https://www.lunabeat.com/list_cb.php"]sign up to our newsletter here[/url] to get notified when we launch a new cool update![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions about the game, reach out to us [url="mailto:mail@lunabeat.com"]via email[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/dREkEjC3TY"]join or Discord.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for checking out your game, have a chill weekend, and we'll see you soon with more updates![/p][p][/p][p]🎁 Features Added[/p][p]-Fish inventory shows the number of fish you have caught so far[/p][p]-Volume sliders for master volume, music and sound effects added to options (press Esc to access options)[/p][p][/p][p]🐛 Bugs patched[/p][p]-Chatbox improvements[/p][p][/p][p]🐝 Bugs we're aware of and working to fix[/p][p]-Sometimes the camera snaps to look at nearby scenery and you lose your character, we believe this is a timeout bug, patching soon[/p][p]-If you're close to an NPC on someone else's island, the keyboard controls remain active with the chatbox when typing[/p][p]-If you jump on top of another cat and try to fish while standing on their head, your avatar's pose is frozen[/p][p]-Sometimes the font changes to another font for random letters (pretty sure this is fixed)[/p]

[url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdKTISOAzWcjf9EmmQ5bM7ChFgZIKdw6uMFnWQV_OcPNA-SFA/viewform"]Sign up here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for checking out Cozy Beach, and happy fishing! 🎣[/p]

notes.title: Cozy Beach Demo Launch! Patch notes & fixes to come
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]What an exciting week!  Our lil' indie team has been hard at work for months prepping the Cozy Beach demo, and we're so thrilled that it's available for everyone to play now![/p][p][/p][p]Our goal for this initial version of the demo was to give everyone a taste of the vibe we're going for, and some fun basic fishing and chatting features.[/p][p][/p][p]Some dev notes:[/p][p]We patched a few bugs this week, and have plans to patch a few more!  Details are below.[/p][p]We also have plans to update the demo as we develop the game!  Keep your eyes out for updates this year with customizable characters, apparel, more interactive NPCs, more fish and emotes, apparel, collectibles, crafting and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you also for your patience with stray bugs as we get everything ironed out and working smoothly 🙏 we'll be posting patch notes as we go with what gets fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]We also welcome your feedback about the demo!  Here's a [url="https://forms.gle/JFpCrKAxUFADWf4W8"]feedback form[/url], or just hit reply on this and let us know.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for checking out Cozy Beach and for playing the demo!  We hope you have a great time, and hope to see you back soon for more with future updates! 😸[/p][p][i]-LunaBeat[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🐛 Bugs patched this week[/b][/p][p]-Bug where you fell forever when joining an island fixed[/p][p]-Bug where you spawned under the sand fixed[/p][p]-Bug where your avatar froze after an animation fixed[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where you froze in place on spawn[/p][p]-Sometimes the fishing line will get caught on something, or fish will get trapped under the ground - we added a "Cut the line" feature to escape situations like these[/p][p]-The emote wheel persisted sometimes without a way to dismiss it, we made it so pressing "Esc" clears the emote wheel[/p][p]-Changed the text color in the chat balloon to make it easier to read[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where a 2nd player joining an island would have their controls remapped from keyboard & mouse to an Xbox controller (??)[/p][p]-Little boot icons from the chatters list would persist on the player screen[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐝 Bugs we're aware of and working to fix[/b][/p][p]-In multiplayer, the chatbox "grabs" the controls from players and moves their avatars while typing (WASD & spacebar)[/p][p]-If you jump on top of another cat and try to fish while standing on their head, your avatar's pose is frozen[/p][p]-Audio balancing - we'll be adding volume sliders for music, sound effects and overall volume soon[/p][p]-Sometimes the font changes to another font for random letters[/p][p]-Sometimes the camera snaps to look at nearby scenery and you lose your character (this might be fixed, I am not 100% sure)[/p][p][/p][p][b]🐞Bugs we might leave cause they're hilarious[/b][/p][p]-If you use an emote to lie on the ground, you can both jump and fish while lying down.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing Cozy Beach!! 🏝😸[/p]

notes.title: Cozy Beach is part of Steam's Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.notes:
Wow, the first event for our new game, how exciting!! 💖

We're so pleased to announce that Cozy Beach is part of the Steam Couch Co-Op festival!

🏝 Cozy Beach is all about hangin' with your friends, whether it's online or in the living room.  Use our handy split-screen mode so you and your IRL pal can fish, tube, dance and relax to your heart's content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480592/bbd03ad2ca96ed0c787ef9b691531e10fd638432.png[/img]

We're working hard on the game and plan to bring a demo to you all in the coming months so you can try it out.  Our goal is to involve the community as much as possible - so if you want to stay on top of the latest developments and make your voice heard, join our community!

Here's some quick links in order of ultra-coolness:
